title: •Yerka Mig
caption: •Yerka Mig (V)
game_text: Deploy on Cantina. While all your ability on table is provided by aliens and {independent} starship pilots: whenever you deploy a unique (•) alien to a battleground, may retrieve 1 Force; and, during battle, your total power is +3. If opponent controls this location, this Effect lost.
lore: An Imperial bureaucrat with high security clearance who resigned and fled in remorse after the occupation of his home planet, Ralltiir. Now a fugitive from the ISB.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Printed base is a Utinni Effect; slip banner reads EFFECT, no grabber box. Inline blue wheel icon before 'starship pilots' → {independent} (stub expands 'Independent'). 'unique (•)' as printed. Slip text otherwise matches the stub. Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Premiere prints no expansion ring. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1995 (Premiere) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350 px).
